ruling.meaning: remove the links and file: record the reviewer-made .live symlinks and their targets here, remove only those links, and file the attempt

standing_rule: A later attempt of this run, or of 2026-11-26-codex-ce-astra-high-bwrap, whose filing fails only because of `.live` symlinks inside its report folder (clone-work/ce-review-artifacts) that point to its own session rollouts under the attempt's home/.codex/sessions gets the same treatment: its links and targets are appended to `applications` in this file, only those links are removed, and the attempt is filed. Any other filing failure, or a link that points anywhere else, stops for a ruling.
cause: The frozen invocation asks the reviewer to preserve its native result 'with the complete run directory and native Codex root/child session evidence'. The reviewer wrote native-sessions/ in its report folder with a copy of each root and child rollout and, beside each copy, a `.live` symlink to the live rollout in the attempt's own home. file-attempt refuses a native artifact that resolves outside the report folder ('native artifact is missing or escapes its root'). Every target is a file inside the attempt directory, and the transcript archive holds the same rollouts. The copies, the rest of the report folder and every other file stay unchanged.
